fragments.text: תַּאֲלַת זוֹ כְּחָפֵץ לְהוֹעִיל. שׁוּעַ עֲרוֹךְ לִמְּדָם לְהוֹעִיל. רוֹן הַרְרֵי קֶדֶם הַמּוֹעִיל. קְרוֹא בְגָרוֹן מוֹקֵשׁ לְהַגְעִיל: צִדְקָם לְהַקְפוֹת בְּנִיב שְׁוָעָה. פָּעֳלָם בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים לְשַׁמֵּעָה. עֵת רָצוֹן וְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָה. סְבִיכַת קֶרֶן וּכְרוֹת שְׁבוּעָה: נוֹבְבִים בְּגִישַׁת הַיוֹמַת תִּשְׁעָה. מִסְפַּר שְׁמוֹת וְחוֹתְמֵיהֶן הַתִּשְׁעָה. לְמִנְיַן פְּלִיל שֵׁמוֹת הַתִּשְׁעָה. כְּתַחֲנַת עֲקָרָה יַלְדָּה שִׁבְעָה: יַאֲמִירוּ עֹז מַלְכוּת עֶשֶׂר. טְבוּעוֹת לְשֵׁם בֻּחַן בָּעֶשֶׂר. חֹק זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְקוֹלוֹת עֶשֶׂר. זֵכֶר מְבֹרָךְ

גְּבִיר בְּעֶשֶׂר: וַיֶּפֶן בָּאָהוּב אַחֲרוֹ נַהֲרִים. הֶעָקוּד בְּהַר מוֹר אַחֲרוּים. דִּשְׁנוֹ יֵרֶא לָחֹן שֵׁירַיִם. גִּישַׁת עַנְיוֹ בֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם: בְּזֶה פֶּרֶק חוּג עֲתִירָה. בְּעַד אֲמוּרָה עַד הוּתָרָה. אֶנְקַת אָסִיר אָז כּוֹכְתָרָה. אֵלַי לְהֵעָתֵר כְּמוֹ נֶעְתָּרָה:

When He wished to heal the folly of His people, He taught them to arrange prayer so that it should be of help, the valued prayer of the primaeval mountains, to call aloud in order to scare the accuser. He taught them to affirm their righteousness with an outburst of entreaty, to recall at a time of favour and on the day of salvation their toil over the years, the ram caught in the thicket, the covenant and the oath. They recite the prayer with nine benedictions, nine is the number of blessings and their endings, according to the names of God in that prayer which the childless one (Hannah) uttered, who later gave birth to seven children. They revere in ten verses the acknowledgment of divine rule, they are based on him who was ten times tested (Abraham), the measure of remembrance and of Shofar tones is ten in memory of him who with ten blessings made his son master. May He gaze upon the beloved son of him who was brought out of Mesopotamia, who was bound hand and foot on Mount Moriah, let Him behold his ashes so as to be gracious to his descendants, who approach Him morning and noon. On this day he (Isaac) fervently entreated on behalf of his childless wife, until she too was remembered. As the sighs of the childless one were answered then, so let my prayer too be heard as hers was heard.

תַּאֲלַת זוּ כְּחֵפֶץ לְהַתְעִיל. שׁוּעַ עֲרוֹךְ לְמָרֹם לְהוֹעִיל. רוֹן הַרְרֵי קֶדֶם הַמּוֹעִיל. קְרוֹא בְּגָרוֹן מוֹקֵשׁ לְהַגְעִיל: צִדְקָם לְהַקְפוֹת בְּנִיב שַׁוְעָה. פָּעֳלָם בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים לְשָׁמְעָה. עֵת רָצוֹן וְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָה. סְבִיכַת קֶרֶן וּבְרִית שְׁבוּעָה: נוֹבְבִים בְּגִשַׁת חוֹתָמוֹת תִּשְׁעָה. מִסְפַּר שָׁתוֹת וְחוֹתְמֵיהֶן תִּשְׁעָה. לְמִנְיַן פִּלּוּל שֵׁמוֹת תִּשְׁעָה. כְּחַנָּה עֲקָרָה יָלְדָה שִׁבְעָה: יַאֲמִירוּ עֹז מַלְכֻיּוֹת עֶשֶׂר. טְבוּעוֹת לְשֵׁם בֻּחַן בְּעֶשֶׂר. חֹק זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְקוֹלוֹת עֶשֶׂר. זֵכֶר מְבָרֵךְ

גְּבִיר בְּעֶשֶׂר: וַיִּפֶן בָּאָהוּב אַתוּי נַהֲרִים. הֶעָקוּד בְּהַר מוֹר אֲחוֹרִים. דִּשְׁנוֹ יֵרֶא לָחֹן שֵׁירַיִם. גָּשִׁים עָדָיו בְּקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם: בְּזֶה פֶּרֶק חִנֵּן עֲתִירָה. בְּעַד אֲסוּרָה עַד הֻתָּרָה.
אֶנְקַת אָסִיר אָז כְּהִכְתָרָה. אֵלִי לְהֵעָתֵר כְּמוֹ נֶעְתָּרָה:

When He wished to heal the folly of His people, He taught them to arrange prayer so that it should be of help, the valued prayer of the primaeval mountains, to call aloud in order to scare the accuser. He taught them to affirm their righteousness with an outburst of entreaty, to recall at a time of favour and on the day of salvation their toil over the years, the ram caught in the thicket, the covenant and the oath. They recite the prayer with nine benedictions, nine is the number of blessings and their endings, according to the names of God in that prayer which the childless one (Hannah) uttered, who later gave birth to seven children. They revere in ten verses the acknowledgment of divine rule, they are based on him who was ten times tested (Abraham), the measure of remembrance and of Shofar tones is ten in memory of him who with ten blessings made his son master. May He gaze upon the beloved son of him who was brought out of Mesopotamia, who was bound hand and foot on Mount Moriah, let Him behold his ashes so as to be gracious to his descendants, who approach Him morning and noon. On this day he (Isaac) fervently entreated on behalf of his childless wife, until she too was remembered.
As the sighs of the childless one were answered then, so let my prayer too be heard as hers was heard.
